==Notes==
*Twin Moon Sweep always attacks only once, even when an enchantment is removed. However, it hits twice in the latter case.
*Melee [[weapon]]s with a [[Vampiric]] mod, [[Vow of Strength]], [[Hundred Blades]], [[Order of the Vampire]], [[Conjure Flame]]/[[Conjure Frost|Frost]]/[[Conjure Lightning|Lightning]], etc. synergize well with Twin Moon Sweep because the effect triggers twice.
*Unlike [[Dual attack]]s, both attacks from this skill hit simultaneously, meaning both hits will connect even through skills such as [[Shield Bash]] or [[Shield of Judgment]].
{{anomaly|The concise description incorrectly states the target is attacked twice, instead of hit twice.}}
